title: Ladybug
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='22' y='46' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <rect x='20' y='62' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='46' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='62' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <rect x='26' y='76' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='76' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a2a2a'/>
  <!-- body (red shell) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='30' ry='27' fill='#e23b2e'/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='44' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#f06a5c'/>
  <!-- wing split line -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='32' width='3' height='50' rx='1.5' fill='#a81f1a'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='50' r='6' fill='#2c2140'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='50' r='6' fill='#2c2140'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='5.5' fill='#2c2140'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='68' r='5.5' fill='#2c2140'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='72' r='4.5' fill='#2c2140'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='13' fill='#2c2140'/>
  <!-- head shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='25' r='4' fill='#4a3a68'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='30' r='3.2' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='30' r='3.2' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
  <circle cx='45.5' cy='30.5' r='1.5' fill='#1a1428'/>
  <circle cx='55.5' cy='30.5' r='1.5' fill='#1a1428'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <rect x='40' y='12' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#2c2140' transform='rotate(-20 41 17)'/>
  <rect x='57' y='12' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#2c2140' transform='rotate(20 58 17)'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='11' r='3' fill='#2c2140'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='11' r='3' fill='#2c2140'/>
</svg>
